name: X-IIoTID
publication: Alhawawreh et al., 'X-IIoTID: A New Multi-Tier Industrial IoT Intrusion Detection Dataset', IEEE Access, 2021
description: A comprehensive multi-tier Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) intrusion dataset that captures device-level, network-level, and application-level activity across diverse industrial protocols and attack stages.
purpose: Industrial network traffic, device events, application activity and multi-stage attack behaviour
class_imbalance_notes: Severe class imbalance between benign supervisory polling (approx. 88%) and multi-stage attack artifacts (12%), reflecting realistic industrial deployments.
missing_fields: Physical process telemetry (pressure, RPM, vibration sensor values)
known_limitations: Simulated multi-tier testbed rather than a live factory floor; does not include proprietary Indian MSME SMT / pick-and-place equipment protocols.
relevance_to_becpl: Highly relevant for BECPL VLAN 30 (OT) Modbus TCP attack modeling and multi-stage malware propagation detection.
citation: Alhawawreh, M., Sitnikova, E., & Aboutorab, N. (2021). X-IIoTID: A New Multi-Tier Industrial IoT Intrusion Detection Dataset. IEEE Access, 9, 32521-32537.

name: ToN_IoT
publication: Al-Zewairi et al. / Moustafa, 'A New Distributed Architecture for Evaluating AI-based Security Systems in IoT Environments', IEEE Internet of Things Journal, 2020
description: Telemetry collected from a realistic testbed combining Industrial IoT devices, fog nodes, Windows/Linux endpoints, and cloud services, capturing heterogeneous telemetry including network pcaps, Zeek logs, and host event logs.
purpose: Heterogeneous IoT and network telemetry evaluation with correlated host, network, and industrial sensor data
class_imbalance_notes: Imbalanced distribution across 9 attack families; scanning and DoS comprise majority of attack instances while data injection has fewer samples.
missing_fields: Explicit enterprise identity mapping (human user vs service account)
known_limitations: Network topologies reflect a generic smart-city testbed rather than an electronics assembly / PCB fabrication plant.
relevance_to_becpl: Provides directly comparable Zeek connection logs and Windows/Linux audit events matching VaultX's sensor pipeline.
citation: Moustafa, N. (2020). A New Distributed Architecture for Evaluating AI-based Security Systems at the Edge: The Ton_IoT Datasets. IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems.

name: CSE-CIC-IDS2018
publication: Sharafaldin et al., 'Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Evaluation', ICISSP, 2018
license: Open Data License (Communications Security Establishment & Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity)
description: Large-scale enterprise network dataset collected from 420 machines across 5 departments with benign user activity profiles and diverse external attack campaigns.
purpose: Enterprise-scale lateral movement, brute force, and web application attack modeling
class_imbalance_notes: Benign flows constitute ~83% of total dataset, while Infiltration and Heartbleed constitute < 0.1%.
known_limitations: Massive raw pcap size (~400 GB); network architecture uses Canadian public sector enterprise topology.
relevance_to_becpl: Directly models BECPL VLAN 10 (Corporate IT) and VLAN 50 (DMZ) attack vectors like SSH brute forcing and web application probing.
citation: Sharafaldin, I., Lashkari, A. H., & Ghorbani, A. A. (2018). Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Evaluation. In ICISSP (pp. 108-116).

name: HAI 22.04 (Hardware-in-the-Loop Augmented ICS Dataset)
publication: Shin et al., 'HAI 1.0: Hardware-in-the-Loop Augmented ICS Dataset for Anomaly Detection', IEEE ICPS, 2020
description: Physical process and operational dataset collected from a hardware-in-the-loop industrial testbed consisting of boiler, turbine, water treatment, and HIL simulator.
purpose: Industrial cyber-physical anomaly detection and multi-variable sensor correlation
class_imbalance_notes: Highly imbalanced: > 95% continuous operational steady-state physical measurements, < 5% anomalous disturbance windows.
missing_fields: Network packet payload details (EVE / Conn logs)
known_limitations: Covers thermal, chemical, and fluid dynamics rather than surface mount electronics pick-and-place or reflow soldering machines.
relevance_to_becpl: Provides the mathematical benchmark for multivariate process time-series anomaly detection in manufacturing environments.
citation: Shin, H. K., Lee, W., Yun, J. H., & Min, B. G. (2020). Two ICS Datasets for Cyber Attack Detection: HAI 1.0 and HAI 2.0. In IEEE ICPS.

name: CIC-IDS2017
publication: Sharafaldin et al., 'Generating Realistic Intrusion Detection Dataset based on Fuzzy Logic', IEEE CSE, 2017
license: Open Data License (Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity)
description: Standard benchmark dataset capturing 5 days of normal and attack traffic covering contemporary network protocol implementations and attack tools.
purpose: Multi-class network intrusion detection benchmarking and baseline flow feature extraction
attack_types: Web Attack (Brute Force, XSS, Sql Injection)
class_imbalance_notes: Attacks on Tuesday and Wednesday are heavily outnumbered by Monday's purely benign baseline.
known_limitations: Older timestamping (2017); known packet duplication anomalies in some CSV subsets.
relevance_to_becpl: Foundational comparison dataset for standard IT classifier accuracy benchmarks.
citation: Sharafaldin, I., Gharib, A., Lashkari, A. H., & Ghorbani, A. A. (2017). Towards generating a new intrusion detection dataset and intrusion evaluation. ICISSP.

name: UNSW-NB15
publication: Moustafa & Slay, 'UNSW-NB15: A comprehensive data set for network intrusion detection systems', MilCIS, 2015
description: Hybrid synthetic and real modern network traffic dataset generated via the IXIA PerfectStorm tool, providing low-level network flow features and packet metrics.
purpose: Network anomaly classification with realistic low-footprint attack representation
class_imbalance_notes: Well-documented train/test split provided by authors (175,341 training records, 82,332 testing records).
known_limitations: Synthesized traffic generator artifacts present in TCP window and TTL distributions.
relevance_to_becpl: Used to validate the baseline ML flow classifier before manufacturing-specific feature enrichment.
citation: Moustafa, N., & Slay, J. (2015). UNSW-NB15: a comprehensive data set for network intrusion detection systems. In MilCIS (pp. 1-6).
